name: com.strybok.sdk
description: Receives iOS Universal Links and Android App Links, resolves them through the Strybok API to an in-app route and payload, and delivers each link exactly once: on cold start, from the background and in the foreground. Restoring a link tapped before installation (deferred links) and links without an API call (path links and Firebase long links) are optional and off by default; for deferred links the game supplies the store's install referrer or the pasted link.
